verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh lets users subscribe webhooks to specific event types such as `WORKFLOW_COMPLETED`, so a product event automatically triggers an outbound callback. Users can also configure the risk-score equation and multiple screening configurations, which govern how screening runs. This is only a thin form of event-triggered automation; any action beyond the callback has to be built by the consumer. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule engine (if-event-then-action), automatic in-product actions such as auto-assigning or auto-deciding cases or alerts, conditional rule logic beyond the risk equation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
